title: Complete guarded cheat application acceptance audit
changes: Mark DBG2-19 complete within the supported isolated interpreter: explicit source-bound preview, one-shot, frame-boundary maintenance, overlap checks and disarm have defined behavior and failure guards.
validation: A synthetic isolated Wine/Xvfb proof verified three exact bus writes while paused, unchanged frame/clock/registers, stale state and source refusal, and no duplicate on retry. A separate maintained-set proof verified arming writes nothing, overlap refusal without mutation, two frame applications, disarm and unchanged original inputs.

Existing isolated Wine/Xvfb tests verified load and Undo disarm and restore the expected machine state. Current preflight checks the entire plan before guest bus access and restricts writes to canonical aligned RAM; native, ROM, mirrors and I/O writes are refused.
limitations: The supported timing is an interpreter frame boundary, not an original device hook. Disarming stops future writes but does not undo prior ones. Native Windows, physical input and broader device/gameplay equivalence are not established; unsupported memory/backend cases remain refused.
